new_cluster_names<-

```{r}
meta_data_all <- tibble(cluster=seurat_c1_full_FG$cluster_clean,
       donor=seurat_c1_full_FG$donor,
       purification= seurat_c1_full_FG$purification,
       condition_per_sample=seurat_c1_full_FG$group_per_sample,
       days_post_symptom_onset=seurat_c1_full_FG$days_after_onset,
       disease_stage=seurat_c1_full_FG$disease_stage)

meta_data_donor_day <- meta_data_all %>%
  mutate(donor_day=paste0(donor,"__",days_post_symptom_onset)) %>% 
  group_by(cluster,donor_day) %>% 
  summarise(n=n())%>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "cluster",values_from = n) %>% ungroup()

meta_data_condition_per_sample_donor_day <- meta_data_all %>%
  mutate(condition_per_sample_donor_day=paste0(group_per_sample,"__0_",donor, "_",days_post_symptom_onset)) %>% 
  group_by(cluster,condition_per_sample_donor_day) %>% 
  summarise(n=n())%>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "cluster",values_from = n) %>% ungroup() %>% replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% rename(sample=condition_per_sample_donor_day)

meta_data_condition_per_sample_donor_day

meta_data_condition_per_sample_donor_day_grouping <- meta_data_condition_per_sample_donor_day %>% 
  select(condition_per_sample_donor_day) %>% 
  separate(col=condition_per_sample_donor_day, sep="__", into = c("condition","donor_day"),remove = FALSE) %>% 
  select(condition_per_sample_donor_day,condition) %>% rename(sample=condition_per_sample_donor_day)

meta_data_all_n %>% write_csv(paste0(path_output_file,"meta_data_all_n.csv"))
meta_data_groups %>% write_csv(paste0(path_output_file,"meta_data_groups.csv"))

meta_data_condition_per_sample_donor_day %>% write_csv(paste0(path_output_file,"meta_data_condition_per_sample_donor_day.csv"))
meta_data_condition_per_sample_donor_day_grouping %>% write_csv(paste0(path_output_file,"meta_data_condition_per_sample_donor_day_grouping.csv"))
```
```{r}
meta_data_all <- tibble(cluster=seurat_c1_full_FG$cluster_clean,
       donor=seurat_c1_full_FG$donor,
       purification= seurat_c1_full_FG$purification,
       condition_per_sample=seurat_c1_full_FG$group_per_sample,
       days_post_symptom_onset=seurat_c1_full_FG$days_after_onset,
       disease_stage=seurat_c1_full_FG$disease_stage)


meta_data_condition_per_sample_donor_day <- meta_data_all %>%
  mutate(condition_per_sample_donor_day=paste0(group_per_sample,"__0_",donor, "_",days_post_symptom_onset)) %>% 
  mutate(cluster=str_replace_all(cluster,
 c( "cd8_t_3"="CD8_T_cells",
    "cd8_t_2"="CD8_T_cells",
    "cd8_t"="CD8_T_cells",
    "m_d_cs"= "mDCs",
    "cd4_t_3"="CD4_T_cells",
    "cd4_t_2"="CD4_T_cells",
    "cd4_t"="CD4_T_cells",
    "b_3"="B_cells",
    "b_2"="B_cells",
    "plasmablasts"="B_cells",
    "b"="B_cells",
    "p_d_cs"="pDCs",
    "hla_d_rhi_cd83_monocytes"="HLA_DRhi_CD83_Monocytes",
    "classical_monocytes" ="Classical_Monocytes",
    "cd163hi_monocytes_1_d7"="CD163hi_Monocytes_donor1_day1",
    "non_classical_monocytes"="Non_classical_Monocytes",
    "neutrophils" ="Neutrophils" ,
    "hla_d_rlo_s100a_monocytes"="HLA_DRlo_s100a_Monocytes",
    "megakaryocyte"="Megakaryocyte",
    "nk"="NK"
    
    )
  )) %>% 
  group_by(cluster,condition_per_sample_donor_day) %>% 
  summarise(n=n())%>% ungroup()  %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "cluster",values_from = n) %>% ungroup() %>% replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  rename(sample=condition_per_sample_donor_day) %>% select(-mixed,-undefined)

meta_data_condition_per_sample_donor_day

meta_data_condition_per_sample_donor_day_grouping <- meta_data_condition_per_sample_donor_day %>% 
  select(sample) %>% 
  separate(col=sample, sep="__", into = c("condition","donor_day"),remove = FALSE) %>% 
  select(sample,condition) 

meta_data_condition_per_sample_donor_day %>% write_csv(paste0(path_output_file,"meta_data_condition_per_sample_donor_day.csv"))
meta_data_condition_per_sample_donor_day_grouping %>% write_csv(paste0(path_output_file,"meta_data_condition_per_sample_donor_day_grouping.csv"))
```

```{r}
Idents(seurat_monocytes) <- "cluster_clean"
seurat_monocytes_markers <- read_rds(paste0(path_data_file, "seurat_monocytes_markers.rds") )
#seurat_monocytes_markers<- FindAllMarkers(seurat_monocytes,max.cells.per.ident = 400)
plan('sequential')
additional_markers_mono<- FindAllMarkers(seurat_monocytes, features = genes_manual_select_1, logfc.threshold = 0,min.pct = 0, return.thresh = 1)
#CD163_fc<- FindAllMarkers(seurat_monocytes, features = "CD163", logfc.threshold = 0,min.pct = 0, return.thresh = 1)
#HLADRB5 <- - FindAllMarkers(seurat_monocytes, features = "HLA-DRB5", logfc.threshold = 0,min.pct = 0, return.thresh = 1)
seurat_monocytes_markers_add <- seurat_monocytes_markers %>% as_tibble()%>%  bind_rows(as_tibble(additional_markers_mono)) %>% select(-p_val,-p_val_adj) %>% distinct(gene,cluster, .keep_all = T)
#seurat_monocytes_markers %>% write_rds(paste0(path_output_file, "seurat_monocytes_markers_w_additional.rds"))

seurat_monocytes_markers %>% filter(!(str_detect(gene, pattern = "RP")), avg_log2FC>0) %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_min(p_val_adj, n=30)

```

```{r}
meta_data <- tibble(disease_stage=seurat_monocytes$disease_stage, cluster=seurat_monocytes$cluster_clean,donor=seurat_monocytes$donor, day_pso=seurat_monocytes$days_after_onset, severity= seurat_monocytes$group_per_sample)
meta_data %>%
  group_by(cluster, severity, donor) %>% 
  summarise(n=n()) %>% 
  #ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(donor) %>%
  mutate(sum_per_donor=sum(n), freq_of_donor_per_cluster=n/sum(n)) %>% arrange(cluster,desc(freq_of_donor_per_cluster)) 
```
```{r}
library(ggbeeswarm)
meta_data %>%
  group_by(cluster, severity, donor,day_pso) %>% 
  summarise(n=n()) %>% 
  #ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(donor) %>%
  mutate(sum_per_donor=sum(n),freq_of_donor_per_cluster=n/sum(n)) %>%
  arrange(donor) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=severity,y=freq_of_donor_per_cluster, color=day_pso))+geom_quasirandom()+facet_grid(~cluster)
```
```{r}
meta_data %>%
  group_by(cluster, severity, donor,day_pso) %>% 
  summarise(n=n()) %>% 
  #ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(donor) %>%
  mutate(sum_per_donor=sum(n),freq_of_donor_per_cluster=n/sum(n)) %>%
  arrange(donor) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=day_pso,y=freq_of_donor_per_cluster, color=severity))+geom_point()+facet_grid(~cluster)
```
